name: Curcumin

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The principal curcuminoid of turmeric, taken for anti-inflammatory effect. Bioavailability is poor and is commonly enhanced with piperine or lipid formulations. Turmeric and curcumin products are a recognised and rising cause of herb-induced liver injury.

systems.note: Taken for anti-inflammatory effect; the intended effect.
Turmeric and curcumin are a documented and increasing cause of herb-induced liver injury, notably with bioavailability enhancers.

monitors.why: Documented and rising herb-induced liver injury; this is the specific, non-generic concern for this supplement.
The reported injury pattern includes a hepatocellular picture with jaundice.
Read with ALT to characterise the injury as hepatocellular.
The accessible index of the anti-inflammatory effect claimed.
